headline: Linn Mercy and Expanse Fighting Quickens; Marban Hollow Work Goes Neutral
war_summary: The great battles at Linn Mercy and in the Weathered Expanse have quickened rather than eased since the last edition, both fronts now posting their heaviest hourly losses of the day. At Linn Mercy the lines hold at eight Colonial works, two Warden and one unclaimed, but the guns have grown louder — some 740 Colonial and 1,363 Warden casualties the hour, with both figures still rising. The Weathered Expanse reports five Warden works, one Colonial and three unclaimed, unchanged in count, with forty-four actions logged in the day and hourly losses near 743 Colonial and 1,025 Warden. In Marban Hollow the brisk work of the forenoon has cooled; one Colonial work has passed to no-man's-land, leaving three Colonial, three Warden and two unclaimed about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. The Nevish Line, silent six hours at the last writing, has spoken twice in the past two hours and counted forty-two actions in the day, its line still seven Warden works with one unclaimed. Mooring County's guns have fallen quiet again, though its twelve Warden works stand. Elsewhere the map remains largely Colonial, Warden strength concentrated in the northern and western counties.
